prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a parking lot collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1014; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Inspection of the rear bumper cover, left quarter panel and tail lamp assembly shows damage consistent with the reported low-speed impact in the parking area. Paint transfer and crush pattern line up with the contact point described, and no prior damage or unrelated repairs are known on this vehicle. The proposed plan is to replace the bumper cover, repair and refinish the quarter panel, and swap the tail lamp, with labor hours that fit the scope of the work. Two similar charges posted on the same day are currently under review and will be confirmed with the shop before payment is released.
